label: For "Credit Committee Memo Drafting Copilot": Draft the credit memo for a corporate facility from the bank's own sources, with every number and claim cited, so analysts spend their time on judgment. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluating on memos the retriever has seen inflates grounding.
